question: What will Trump's net approval (approve minus disapprove) be in the RealClearPolitics average on October 15, 2026?

calls.reasoning: The RCP net is about -21.8 to -22.1 as of Oct 1-5, 2026 (38.2-38.4 approve / 60.2-60.3 disapprove). The status quo with a ~3-week rolling window and a 10-day horizon points to a median near the current value. There is a slight downward lean: a new Reuters/Ipsos 32/65 poll is entering, and other aggregators sit lower (-24 to -27). Rotation of Rasmussen and Harvard-Harris could offset it. The 10-90 width comes from the historical 10-day volatility of RCP net. Markets: Kalshi has RCP approve-% contracts (not net); I could not fetch October prices. No Polymarket or Manifold match was found. No mechanism for escaping the -28/-14 bounds in 10 days.
